result.instructions: Tools for the user's Quire notes vault (2 notes); edits are allowed and every edit is saved in version history. Cite notes as [[Note]] when you use them.

tools.description: Search the user's notes by keywords and meaning. Supports "phrases", #tag filters and -exclusions. Returns note paths, sections and snippets.
tools.name: search_notes

tools.description: Read a note's full Markdown by path (e.g. "Projects/Plan.md") or by title.
tools.name: read_note

tools.description: List notes, optionally only in a folder or with a tag.
tools.name: list_notes

tools.description: Notes that link to a note, with the linking line.
tools.name: backlinks

tools.description: Retrieve the passages most relevant to a question, with citations like [[Note#Heading]] and a short extractive answer. Use it to ground your own answer in the user's notes.
tools.name: ask_notes

tools.description: Create a new note. Never overwrites: a unique name is chosen.
tools.name: create_note

tools.description: Append Markdown to the end of an existing note.
tools.name: append_to_note

tools.description: Find and replace text in one note. Set regex=true for regular expressions with $1 captures.
tools.name: replace_in_note
